description: Source code for F1AP positioning activation procedure, including functions for encoding/decoding ASN.1 messages, handling procedure logic, and managing positioning activation requests and responses within a 3GPP-based system.

classes.name: f1ap_positioning_activation_procedure
classes.description: Handles the positioning activation procedure, including sending requests, handling responses, and managing procedure state.

methods.name: fill_asn1_positioning_activation_request
methods.description: Encodes a positioning activation request into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: fill_positioning_activation_response
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 positioning activation response into a common response structure.

methods.name: fill_positioning_activation_failure
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 positioning activation failure into a common failure structure.

methods.name: ref_sig_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts spatial relation reference signals to ASN.1 format.
